name: abbreviated_title
description: An abbreviated title obtained from the ISSN Centre. Example: PeerJ

name: alternate_titles
description: Alternate titles for this source, as obtained from the ISSN Centre and individual work records, like Crossref DOIs, that carry the source name as a string. These are commonly abbreviations or translations of the source's canonical name. Example: ["PeerJ", "PeerJ (Corte Madera, CA)"]

name: apc_prices
description: List of objects, each with price (Integer) and currency (String).

fields.name: price
fields.description: APC amount in the given currency. Example: 1395

fields.name: currency
fields.description: ISO 4217 currency code. Example: USD, EUR

name: apc_usd
description: The source's article processing charge in US Dollars, if available from DOAJ. Example: 1395

name: cited_by_count
description: The total number of Works that cite a Work hosted in this source.

name: country_code
description: The country that this source is associated with, represented as an ISO two-letter country code. Example: US, GB, DE

name: counts_by_year
description: works_count and cited_by_count for each of the last ten years, binned by year.

fields.name: year
fields.description: The year the counts refer to. Example: 2024

fields.name: works_count
fields.description: Number of works published in that year.

fields.name: cited_by_count
fields.description: Number of citations received in that year.

fields.name: oa_works_count
fields.description: Number of open access works in this source in the given year.

name: created_date
description: The date this Source object was created in the OpenAlex dataset, expressed as an ISO 8601 date string. Example: 2017-08-08

name: display_name
description: The name of the source. Example: PeerJ

name: homepage_url
description: The starting page for navigating the contents of this source; the homepage for this source's website. Example: https://peerj.com/

name: host_organization
description: The host organization for this source as an OpenAlex ID. This will be an Institution.id if the source is a repository, and a Publisher.id if the source is a journal, conference, or eBook platform (based on the type field). Example: https://openalex.org/P4310320595

name: host_organization_name
description: The display_name from the host_organization, shown for convenience. Example: PeerJ

name: id
description: The OpenAlex ID for this source. Example: https://openalex.org/S1983995261

name: ids
description: External identifiers OpenAlex holds for this source. IDs are expressed as URIs where possible.

fields.name: openalex
fields.description: This source's OpenAlex ID. Same as Source.id Example: https://openalex.org/S1983995261

fields.name: issn_l
fields.description: This source's ISSN-L. Same as Source.issn_l Example: 2167-8359

fields.name: mag
fields.description: This source's Microsoft Academic Graph ID Example: 1983995261

fields.name: issn
fields.description: A list of this source's ISSNs. Same as Source.issn Example: ["2167-8359"]

fields.name: fatcat
fields.description: This source's Fatcat ID Example: https://fatcat.wiki/container/...

fields.name: wikidata
fields.description: This source's Wikidata ID Example: https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q230492

name: is_core
description: Whether this source is identified as a core source by CWTS, used in the Open Leiden Ranking of universities around the world.

name: is_in_doaj
description: Whether this is a journal listed in the Directory of Open Access Journals (DOAJ). Possible values: true | false

name: is_oa
description: Whether this is currently fully-open-access source. This could be true for a preprint repository where everything uploaded is free to read, or for a Gold or Diamond open access journal, where all newly published Works are available for free under an open license. Possible values: true | false

name: issn
description: All ISSNs of this source. Many sources have several (print, electronic), so prefer issn_l for matching. Example: ["2167-8359"]

name: issn_l
description: The ISSN-L identifying this source. This is the Canonical External ID for sources. Example: 2167-8359

name: oa_flip_year
description: Year in which the source flipped to full open access, if it did. Example: 2019

name: societies
description: Societies on whose behalf the source is published and maintained, taken from a crowdsourced list curated by OpenAlex.

fields.name: url
fields.description: Homepage of the society.

fields.name: organization
fields.description: Name of the society. Example: (society name)

name: summary_stats
description: Citation metrics for this source.

fields.name: 2yr_mean_citedness
fields.description: The 2-year mean citedness for this source. Also known as impact factor. Example: 3.14

fields.name: h_index
fields.description: The h-index for this source. Example: 42

fields.name: i10_index
fields.description: The i-10 index for this source. Example: 120

name: topics
description: Topics this source publishes on most.

fields.name: id
fields.description: OpenAlex ID of the topic.

fields.name: display_name
fields.description: Name of the topic. Example: scientometrics and bibliometrics research

fields.name: score
fields.description: Relevance score of the topic for this source. Example: 0.97

fields.name: subfield
fields.description: The subfield (third level of the domain > field > subfield > topic hierarchy).

fields.name: id
fields.description: OpenAlex ID of the subfield. Example: https://openalex.org/subfields/1710

fields.name: display_name
fields.description: Name of the subfield. Example: Information Systems

fields.name: field
fields.description: The field (second level of the topic hierarchy).

fields.name: id
fields.description: OpenAlex ID of the field. Example: https://openalex.org/fields/17

fields.name: display_name
fields.description: Name of the field. Example: Computer Science, Medicine

fields.name: domain
fields.description: The domain (top level of the topic hierarchy).

fields.name: id
fields.description: OpenAlex ID of the domain. Example: https://openalex.org/domains/1

fields.name: display_name
fields.description: Name of the domain. Possible values: Life Sciences | Social Sciences | Physical Sciences | Health Sciences

fields.name: count
fields.description: Number of the source's works tagged with the topic. Example: 812

name: type
description: The type of source Possible values: journal | repository | conference | ebook platform | book series | metadata | other

name: updated_date
description: The last time anything in this Source object changed, expressed as an ISO 8601 date string. This date is updated for any change at all, including increases in various counts. Example: 2026-10-12T05:31:44.211000

name: works_api_url
description: OpenAlex API URL listing the works in this source. Example: https://api.openalex.org/works?filter=primary_location.source.id:S1983995261

name: works_count
description: Number of works in this source.

name: listed_in
description: Indexes and lists this source appears in (e.g. DOAJ, Scopus). Example: ["doaj"]

name: host_organization_lineage
description: OpenAlex IDs of the host organization and all its parent organizations. Example: ["https://openalex.org/P4310320595"]

name: is_in_doaj_since_year
description: Year from which the source has been listed in DOAJ. Example: 2013

name: is_high_oa_rate
description: True if a high share of this source's works are open access.

name: is_high_oa_rate_since_year
description: Year from which the source has had a high open access rate. Example: 2013

name: is_in_scielo
description: True if the source is indexed in SciELO.

name: is_ojs
description: True if the source is hosted on Open Journal Systems (OJS).

name: is_preprint_repository
description: True if the source is a preprint repository.

name: apc_usd_by_year
description: Article processing charge in US dollars for each year.

fields.name: year
fields.description: Year of the APC price. Example: 2024

fields.name: price
fields.description: APC price in US dollars for that year. Example: 1395

name: oa_works_count
description: Number of open access works hosted by this source. Example: 20000

name: first_publication_year
description: Year of the earliest work in this source. Example: 2013

name: last_publication_year
description: Year of the most recent work in this source. Example: 2026

name: topic_share
description: Topics weighted by their share of this source's works.

fields.name: id
fields.description: OpenAlex ID of the topic.

fields.name: display_name
fields.description: Name of the topic. Example: scientometrics and bibliometrics research

fields.name: value
fields.description: Share of the source's works tagged with the topic. Example: 0.012

fields.name: subfield
fields.description: The subfield this topic belongs to.

fields.name: id
fields.description: OpenAlex ID of the subfield. Example: https://openalex.org/subfields/1710

fields.name: display_name
fields.description: Name of the subfield. Example: Information Systems

fields.name: field
fields.description: The field this topic belongs to.

fields.name: id
fields.description: OpenAlex ID of the field. Example: https://openalex.org/fields/17

fields.name: display_name
fields.description: Name of the field. Example: Computer Science, Medicine

fields.name: domain
fields.description: The domain this topic belongs to.

fields.name: id
fields.description: OpenAlex ID of the domain. Example: https://openalex.org/domains/1

fields.name: display_name
fields.description: Name of the domain. Possible values: Life Sciences | Social Sciences | Physical Sciences | Health Sciences
